Tree of life

Every species in the database, placed by taxonomy (phylum, class, order, family, genus). Branch lengths do not show evolutionary time. Each ring is a behavior domain, and a colored dot means the domain has been recorded for that species. Highlight a domain to see where it occurs. Click a species to open its card.
